# anthropic_federation_issuer (Resource)

Manage a workload identity federation issuer using OIDC discovery or an explicit JWKS URL. Requires an OAuth bearer token with `org:admin`; Admin API keys are not accepted. Destroy archives the issuer. Inline signing keys, custom CAs and custom discovery base URLs are not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_federation_issuer" "github" {
  name       = "github-actions"
  issuer_url = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer_url` (String) Exact JWT issuer (`iss`) value.
- `name` (String) Unique slug identifier (lowercase, digits and hyphens).

### Optional

- `check_jti` (Boolean) Enforce single-use for assertions carrying a `jti` claim.
- `jwks_url` (String) Explicit JWKS endpoint. Omit to use OIDC discovery at the issuer URL.
- `max_jwt_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Maximum assertion lifetime in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the federation issuer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_federation_issuer.github fdis_example
```
